description: Four counters, each holding off until a set number of gates has arrived and then opening a gate of its own, with seven ways of doing that and a jack that passes a signal only while it is open

params.text: Sets how many chops that row counts before its gate opens, 1 to 16
Steps that row through seven modes — Hold For _, Auto Reset, Latch, Trigger, Auto Trigger, Not Not and Auto Not Not — the lamp colour and the hover text naming the one in use
Sets that row's count back to the start
Sets how many chops the gate stays open for in the modes that close it again, 1 to 16

inputs.text: Counts one chop on every rise past 1V, and that count is what the row is waiting on
Counts one chop on every rise past 1V; with no cable the row counts the chops of the Axe jack above it instead
Any voltage away from 0V sets that row's count back to the start
Any voltage away from 0V sets that row's count back to the start; with no cable the row is reset whenever the row above it is
The signal passed to the Talk jack while that row's gate is open; with no cable the Axe voltage is passed instead
The absolute value of the voltage, scaled so that 10V adds 15, is added to the Cuts knob, the total clamped to 16
The absolute value of the voltage, scaled so that 10V adds 15, is added to the knob that sets how long the gate stays open, the total clamped to 16

outputs.text: 10V while that row's gate is open and 0V while it is closed
Whatever the Speak jack of that row carries while its gate is open, and 0V while the gate is closed

notes: Hold For _ opens the gate when the count reaches the Cuts number and closes it again a set number of chops later; Not Not is its exact inverse, open everywhere else
Auto Reset wraps the count round the total of the row's two knobs, so the gate opens and closes over and over; Auto Not Not is its inverse
Latch opens the gate at the Cuts number and leaves it open until a reset; Trigger sends one 8 millisecond pulse there instead, and Auto Trigger an 80 millisecond pulse each time round
the count starts one below zero, so a row needs one chop more than its Cuts number before the gate opens
each row's display reads its two knob settings, turning green while the gate is open and magenta once the count has run past the Cuts number
a change to either knob on a row only takes effect at that row's next chop
every output is monophonic, whatever is patched in
